title: Day 81: FGR Opens 'CIAgate' Criminal Investigation of Chihuahua Fiscalía — Possible Treason Charges; El Checo (CJNG Tecate) Arrested; El Sapo Hunt Continues; 28 Days to FIFA World Cup
detail: Day 81 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). CIAGATE LEGAL ESCALATION — FGR OPENS CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION OF CHIHUAHUA FISCALÍA (May 13–14, 2026): Mexico's Fiscalía General de la República opened two formal investigation lines against Chihuahua's state attorney general's office on May 13, determining that state authorities exceeded federal jurisdiction ('invasión de competencia federal') during the April 17–18 narcolaboratorio operation in the municipality of Morelos, Chihuahua. Key FGR findings: (1) FGR forensic agents arrived at the lab site without receiving chain of custody from state authorities — a critical evidence-handling failure; (2) seven agents linked to the operation — including foreign-national CIA-affiliated civilians who participated without insignia or diplomatic immunity paperwork — declined to provide statements to federal prosecutors; (3) the Morelos narcolaboratorio contained 55,000 liters of liquid chemical precursors, 50+ tons of solid materials, and approximately 2,000 liters of methamphetamine — confirming its industrial scale. The FGR's second investigation line explicitly examines possible 'actos de traición a la patria' (treason against the nation) charges under Mexico's Penal Code and National Security Law, with the Morena bloc accusing Governor Maru Campos of violating Articles 117 and 119 of the Mexican Constitution, which prohibit states from entering alliances with foreign states or allowing foreign forces without federal authorization. El Universal described the dual investigation as 'CIAgate.' Guillermo Arturo Zuany Portillo, Chihuahua's Strategic Operations Fiscal, resigned citing alleged omissions in the laboratory case handling. President Sheinbaum stated at her May 13 press conference: 'The FGR will have the last word [on the CIA case in Chihuahua]' — distancing the federal executive from Chihuahua governor Maru Campos. La Razón (May 14) confirmed the FGR formally added the jurisdictional invasion line to the ongoing national security crimes investigation file. Governor Maru Campos maintains all actions followed legal procedures and were conducted exclusively by Mexican agencies — directly contradicting the FGR's findings of unauthorized foreign civilian participation without insignia and no chain-of-custody transfer. CNN stood by its May 12 report of CIA Ground Branch lethal targeting operations in Mexico (Washington Post, May 13) despite categorical denials from both García Harfuch and CIA spokesperson Liz Lyons ('false and salacious — serves as nothing more than a PR campaign for the cartels'). This represents the most significant juridical escalation of the CIA sovereignty crisis since the April 20 crash that killed two CIA officers. QUINTUPLE BILATERAL PRESSURE TRACK — DAY 81 (MAXIMUM STRESS): (1) CIA Chihuahua sovereignty deadlock + FGR CIAgate criminal investigation opened; (2) DOJ SDNY indictment of Sinaloa Governor Rubén Rocha Moya + 9 officials (at 'temporary leave' since May 2); (3) Sheinbaum's 'irrefutable proof' extradition standard (May 6); (4) U.S. State Dept review of all 53 Mexican consulates; (5) ongoing CJNG interdiction framework. EL CHECO ARRESTED — CJNG TECATE, BAJA CALIFORNIA (May 13, 2026): Baja California state authorities arrested Sergio Serrano alias 'El Checo,' 51, a CJNG regional leader, on May 13 near Rancho Viejo on the Tecate-Ensenada highway following a 30km+ high-speed pursuit during which he deployed firearms and spike strips ('ponchallantas') against pursuing law enforcement. Turned over to FGR. El Checo is identified as a member of 'Los Volteados' — a CJNG faction composed of Sinaloa Cartel defectors who switched allegiance to CJNG in December 2025 — and operated a criminal cell in the Cerro Azul area of Tecate municipality. He had survived two prior Sinaloa assassination attempts (February 3 and April 23, 2026) and had his mother kidnapped during a home invasion in April 2026 — consistent with an active cartel territorial war in the Tecate border zone. Seized: 2 pistols, 2 long guns, 3 tactical vests, 210 rounds (7.62x39 caliber), 6 magazines, 30 methamphetamine packets, stolen 2020 Jeep Rubicon with foreign criminal history. His arrest follows El Salo's capture in the same Tecate zone on April 17 — both were Sinaloa-to-CJNG defectors ('Los Volteados') — confirming the post-Mencho expansion pattern of CJNG incorporating Sinaloa Cartel defectors in the Baja California border corridor. DECAPITATION LEDGER — DAY 81: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11), El Jardinero (arrested April 27, vinculado a proceso Altiplano May 4), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27), El Cabo (arrested May 7), El Chucky/Manzanillo plaza boss (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate regional leader (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials detained. 47+ confirmed CJNG HVTs neutralized in the post-Mencho campaign. EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 81: Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's Federal Security Cabinet top-priority CJNG enforcement target (named May 3). Day 81 with no confirmed capture or elimination — active CJNG military chief maintaining sicario recruitment networks in Jalisco, Michoacán, and Puebla. POST-EL CHUCKY MANZANILLO VOID (Day 5): Port of Manzanillo CJNG plaza command in transition — no successor publicly identified; El 03's Grupo Élite expected to designate replacement within 1–2 week window. ACLED ASSESSMENT (May 12) remains valid: zero CJNG fracture post-Mencho, 'tactical containment,' Michoacán alliance reinforcement with Los Viagras. PLAN KUKULKAN — 28 DAYS: 28 days to FIFA World Cup 2026 June 11 opening match. Guadalajara (Akron Stadium) hosts 4 group-stage matches; 130,000-person nationwide security deployment continues.
